Press <Action:VesselNext />, <Action:VesselPrevious/> to swap between several available craft.<NewLine/>You can press <Action:CameraReferenceFrame/> to switch between the camera modes, or hold right click to pan the camera around. Most UI elements can be repositioned, resized and hidden, by clicking and dragging.<NewLine/>KSA uses fairly traditional craft controls, which can be viewed in the 'Controls' section of the settings menus by pressing <Action:OpenGameSettings/>.<NewLine/>Press <Action:ToggleMap/> to toggle between craft view, and map view. The map view can be useful for planning burns for encounters and exploring the solar system, but controls slightly change while in this mode. You can also use this to prepare burns by left clicking on a point in the orbit.<NewLine/>In the menu bar, you can use 'Universe' -> 'Goto' and you can instantly move to other celestial objects as well as using 'View' -> 'Orbit Lines' to enable or disable orbit lines for the many available celestials. Many other in progress features can be accessed by exploring the menu bar.<NewLine/>Time compression can be increased using <Action:SimSpeedIncrease/> and decreased with <Action:SimSpeedDecrease/>. Ground Tracking can be toggled with <Action:ToggleGroundTracking/> and transfer planning with <Action:ToggleTransferPlan/>.<Separator/>

chinese: 欢迎体验 KSA 预 Alpha 版。<Separator/>初始场景中，你操控的是名为“Rocket”的飞船。按 <Action:VesselNext /> 或 <Action:VesselPrevious/> 可在几艘现有飞船之间切换。<NewLine/>按 <Action:CameraReferenceFrame/> 可切换相机模式；按住鼠标右键可转动视角。大多数界面面板可以通过点击、拖动来移动、调整大小或隐藏。<NewLine/>KSA 使用常见的飞船操控方式。按 <Action:OpenGameSettings/> 打开设置，在“控制”页查看键位。<NewLine/>按 <Action:ToggleMap/> 可切换飞船视图与地图视图。地图适合规划交会机动和探索太阳系，但操控方式会略有变化。在轨道上的某一点单击鼠标左键，也可在该处规划机动。<NewLine/>在菜单栏中，选择“宇宙”→“天体”菜单中的目标，可立即转到其他天体；选择“视图”→“轨道线”，可开关各天体的轨道线。菜单栏中还可以找到其他正在开发的功能。<NewLine/>按 <Action:SimSpeedIncrease/> 提高时间加速倍率，按 <Action:SimSpeedDecrease/> 降低倍率。按 <Action:ToggleGroundTracking/> 打开或关闭地面轨迹，按 <Action:ToggleTransferPlan/> 打开或关闭转移规划。<Separator/>
context: 欢迎弹窗的入门说明；必须保留所有 Action/Separator/NewLine 标记及顺序，Action卡片复用原按键绑定。原文旧称 Goto，此构建实际菜单名 Move Camera To（将相机移至）；中文按现有菜单名说明。仅此弹窗按中文字符拆分换行，不修改全局富文本解析器。
